name: Ship Announcement Card
description: Square 1:1 typographic product-announcement motion card in the 'Ship Week' developer-launch register — a wordmark, a one-line manifesto, a 5-row feature/model table, and an end-slate URL, all revealed by a PARALLEL TYPEWRITER primitive (clip-path inset + ease: steps(N) where N = the line's char count), over a sparse animated cube grid that fills the upper dead air without crossing the text band. Built entirely in HyperFrames (single composition, one paused GSAP timeline) from variables-first markup — every brand value (wordmark, copy, rows JSON, finalRowIndex, url, accent) is a data-composition-variables entry, so it is template-ready at render time with $0 model spend. Identify the signature intro primitive from the source's first 0.5s BEFORE authoring, declare a named motion pattern per layer (drift / hop / twinkle / spread), pin a side-by-side comparison harness from iteration one, and gate background contrast on a 100x100 downscale legibility test. Silent by design.
referenceNotes: No AI-gen refs needed. Supply the brand wordmark, accent HEX, the manifesto line, and the 5-row table copy. A brand logo SVG/PNG is optional (geometric shapes substitute).

slots.description: The brand / wordmark typed out in the hero beat.
Brand accent HEX (the one highlighted chip + tail color).
The one-line manifesto under the wordmark.
JSON array of feature/model rows {k, v} for the 5-row table.
Index of the row that stays on screen during the reverse-out beat.
Optional brand logo (pre-rasterized PNG if it scales >2x); geometric shapes substitute if absent.

doNotCopyLiterally: Identify the source's intro motion primitive from its first 0.5s BEFORE authoring (typewriter vs slide vs fade). Author variables-first so the card is template-ready at v1. Single composition, opacity-gated beats only. Pin a side-by-side comparison harness from iteration one. Gate background contrast on a 100x100 downscale legibility test. Silent by design.
stackSummary: No model calls. HyperFrames single composition (variables-first markup, opacity-gated beats, GSAP timeline on window.__timelines, clip-path + steps() typewriter), ralphy render for the 1080x1080 silent mp4. $0 total. Optional AI-gen variants (logo, copy alts) ~$0.15-0.30.
